title: Wix Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Wix Harmony is a capable AI website builder, but it falls short on SEO control, portability, and backend depth. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform for serious builders.
body_markdown: Blink. It covers Wix's core gaps natively, built-in SEO and AI-search fixes instead of a manual checklist, full portability instead of servers you can never leave, and a real backend instead of a thin data layer, and it's a more complete platform overall: growth tooling, agentic AI features, and human support are all things Wix doesn't offer. More options are compared in our[Wix alternatives](https://blink.new/blog/best-wix-alternatives) guide.
